I've created a complete offer letter for a Senior Software Engineer position in `offer-letter-senior-software-engineer.md`.

## What's Included

The letter follows the employment contract skill's offer letter template, customized for a senior engineering role:

| Section | Details |
|---------|---------|
| **Position Details** | Senior Software Engineer, reports to Engineering Manager, full-time exempt |
| **Compensation** | Base salary, discretionary bonus, equity vesting schedule, optional sign-on bonus |
| **Benefits** | Health insurance, 401(k), PTO, holidays, sick leave, professional development budget |
| **Role Expectations** | Design/code responsibilities, mentorship, code reviews, optional on-call rotation |
| **Contingencies** | Background check, work authorization, required agreements (NDA, IP assignment) |
| **At-Will Language** | Included to avoid implied employment contract |
| **Acceptance Block** | Signature area with deadline clause |

## Before Sending, Customize These Bracketed Items

- **[DATE]** / **[DEADLINE DATE]** — offer date and expiration
- **[CANDIDATE NAME]** / **[COMPANY NAME]** — obvious
- **Salary, bonus %, equity** — fill in actual numbers
- **Tech stack mention** — tailor the responsibilities to your actual stack
- **Location** — office, remote, or hybrid
- **On-call expectation** — include or remove depending on your engineering process

## Recommendations

1. **Fill in every bracket** — any blank or bracketed item left in a signed letter can create ambiguity.
2. **Have legal counsel review** — compensation structures (especially equity and sign-on clawback terms) and at-will language vary by jurisdiction.
3. **Attach the companion documents** — the Confidentiality Agreement and Invention Assignment Agreement should be sent alongside the letter so everything is signed together.

Would you like me to also draft the companion documents (e.g., a **Confidentiality/Invention Assignment Agreement**) or adjust any section — for example, adding remote-work terms or a different equity structure?
